openings.claim: Does local staging improve completeness and elapsed time when pattern grouping, exterior identification and immediate checking are held fixed? A1 changes these together, so any benefit would not identify spatial interference as its cause.
openings.delta: Compare shared trays against local staging while using identical pattern grouping, envelope pattern marks and preclosure checks in both arms. Preserve exact contents and dimensions for participants, with two volunteers, existing supplies and the existing table.
openings.prediction: If spatial interference materially causes errors and delay, locally staged kits will show fewer pre-correction omissions and lower total elapsed time, including staging and checks, alongside fewer crossed reaches.
openings.rival_prediction: Pattern switching or delayed verification is the nearest alternative. With grouping and checks identical, both arms will achieve similar completeness and elapsed time even if local staging reduces crossed reaches.
openings.defeat: Matched batches with fewer crossings under local staging but unchanged or worse omissions and total time would defeat the claimed spatial benefit. A footprint exceeding the existing table defeats this implementation.
openings.probe: Evaluate a bounded comparison using twelve required kits as four three-kit batches, if matching assigned patterns is possible. Alternate shared/local/local/shared layouts; retain the same volunteer responsibilities, grouping, marks and checks. Verify staging fits before proceeding. Record preparation, assembly, audit and replenishment time on the existing tally sheet and inside the 90-minute clock; audit before correcting, then retain complete kits. Proceed only if the remaining required work fits the remaining budget. No full-run success is established.
assumptions: Matching required patterns and quantities across batches is unconfirmed.
Local staging footprint and comparison overhead are unverified.
Twelve kits cannot establish the 60-kit deadline or at-most-one distribution correction; safe completion of the remaining work is unproven.

critiques.issue: The proposed spatial explanation depends on a comparison that also changes grouping, counting and checking. Those changes could explain lower omissions without a causal benefit from local staging. Q1 holds these obligations constant and distinguishes the alternatives.
